faq.q: What is the maximum group size for a boat rental in Marbella in 2029?
faq.a: The maximum passenger count depends on the boat’s license and safety gear. Our fleet ranges from 5 passengers (e.g., Dubhe, Mariah SX21) up to 12 passengers (e.g., Mangusta 80, Ferretti 94, Maiora 26m). No boat can legally carry more than 12 guests in Marbella, and all our charters are fully compliant with local maritime regulations.

faq.q: Can I rent a boat for 15 people in Marbella?
faq.a: No, not legally. Spanish maritime law caps passenger capacity at 12 per vessel for recreational charters. If you have a larger group, you can book two boats simultaneously—for example, an Azimut 39 (11 pax) plus a Mangusta 80 (12 pax) for a total of 23 guests. Contact us via WhatsApp to arrange multi-boat bookings.

faq.q: Which boat has the highest passenger capacity in your fleet?
faq.a: Several boats in our fleet carry 12 passengers: Mangusta 80 (white and grey), Azimut 58 Flybridge, Canados 86, Ferretti 94, K80, and Maiora 26m. All depart from Puerto Banús. For 12 guests, the Mangusta 80 is a popular choice because it includes a free jet ski on the 4-hour minimum charter at €4,719.

faq.q: Are children counted in the passenger limit?
faq.a: Yes, every person on board, including infants and children, counts toward the maximum passenger limit. Life jackets for all ages are provided as part of our safety equipment. If you have a family with small children, boats like the Lagoon 380 (10 pax) or Azimut 39 (11 pax) offer plenty of space and comfort.

faq.q: Do I need to pay extra for a skipper or fuel?
faq.a: No. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21% VAT). There are no hidden costs. The prices shown for Tier A and Tier B boats are all-inclusive.

faq.q: What if my group is smaller than the maximum capacity?
faq.a: You can book any boat for any number of guests up to its legal limit. Smaller groups often prefer the Dubhe (5 pax) or Speedboat (6 pax) for a more intimate experience. Larger groups with fewer than 12 guests might enjoy the Pershing 46 (10 pax) or Fairline Targa 12m (10 pax) for a sporty ride.

faq.q: Can I rent a boat without a skipper in Marbella?
faq.a: No, all our charters come with a licensed skipper included. This is standard practice in Marbella for safety and insurance reasons. You can relax and enjoy the coastline from Puerto Banús to Cabopino without worrying about navigation or mooring.

faq.q: How do I book a boat for a specific group size?
faq.a: Browse our fleet above and pick a boat that matches your group size. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), you can book directly online or via WhatsApp. For Tier B (Mangusta 80) and all other boats, pricing is on request—send us a WhatsApp message with your group size, preferred date, and duration, and we’ll confirm availability.

data.body_html:
Planning a group outing on the Costa del Sol? Knowing the Marbella boat rental group size limits 2029 is essential before you book. Every vessel in our fleet has a legal maximum passenger capacity set by its license and safety equipment—not by us. Whether you’re celebrating a birthday, organising a corporate event, or just enjoying a day at sea with friends, we’ll help you find the right boat for your group. All charters depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. No surprises, just clear numbers.

Why group size limits matter

Spanish maritime law caps recreational charter boats at 12 passengers. This isn’t a suggestion—it’s a safety regulation. Overloading a boat voids insurance and puts everyone at risk. Our entire fleet is fully compliant, and we never exceed the certified capacity. For groups larger than 12, we can arrange multi-boat charters—just ask via WhatsApp.

Pricing for popular group sizes

Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) are the most affordable for groups of 9–11. Prices are all-inclusive: €749 for 2 hours up to €2,299 for 8 hours. For larger groups up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (Tier B) starts at €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter and includes a free jet ski. All other boats are priced on request—just WhatsApp us your group size and preferred date.

How to choose the right boat for your group

Think about your group’s vibe. For a small, romantic trip, the Dubhe (5 pax) is perfect. For a family day out, the Lagoon 380 (10 pax) offers stability and space. For a party with friends, the Mangusta 80 (12 pax) is hard to beat—especially with the free jet ski. If you’re celebrating a milestone, the Ferretti 94 (12 pax) provides unmatched luxury. All depart from Puerto Banús, with easy access to Marbella’s best boat rental options.

Multi-boat bookings for larger groups

Need to accommodate more than 12 guests? We can arrange two or more boats to sail together. For example, an Azimut 39 (11 pax) plus a Mangusta 80 (12 pax) gives you capacity for 23 guests. Contact us via WhatsApp to coordinate itineraries, departure times, and meet-up spots like Cabopino or Cala del Faro.

Every booking comes with: licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No extra charges. You just bring sunscreen and a good mood.
